verdict.rationale: Google Cloud positions Vertex AI as a platform for building 'powerful agentic systems at global scale' and enterprise-grade AI agents, and provides APIs/MCP servers (Cloud Run MCP, genai-toolbox) that let agents interact with cloud resources and databases, implying support for autonomous agent workflows. However, the evidence pack lacks concrete detail on scheduling/triggering mechanisms (e.g., Cloud Scheduler, event triggers, Agent Engine runtime) that would demonstrate automations actually running unattended in the background. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of background/scheduled execution or agent runtime persistence, independent/hands-on confirmation of autonomous operation.
